title: Homework after Lesson 3
note: Two short paragraphs are the main thing here — one in each tense. Everything else is quick.

items.text: Learn the 20 routine words from the Lesson 3 vocabulary — run them through the trainer twice.
Exercise 11: write 80–100 words in two paragraphs — your normal day in the Present Simple, and today in the Present Continuous.
Finish Exercises 12–14 on the lesson page (plans, how long does it take, find the mistake).
Take the quiz in the Grammar section: Present Simple vs Present Continuous (the link is next to Exercise 5 on the lesson page).
Record a one-minute voice message: My normal Wednesday.
Optional: do the exercises on the British Council page for the Roman Britain video.

title: Homework after Lesson 2
note: Do it in parts, not all at once. If something is unclear, tell me and we'll go through it in the lesson.

items.text: Learn 10 new words from the Lesson 2 vocabulary — run them through the trainer twice.
Write 6 sentences about your hobby: 2 in the Present Simple, 2 in the Present Continuous, 2 in the Past Simple.
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: Past Simple and Past Continuous.
Watch one 6 Minute English episode and write down 5 new words.
Prepare a one-minute talk: How I started my hobby.

title: Homework after Lesson 1
note: The first set of words from the reading text.

items.text: Learn the 9 words from Lesson 1 in the vocabulary section.
Write 5 sentences using the new words.
